tabs.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Contoso Manufacturing runs three plants — Derby, Porto and Penang — and a head office in Derby. The company is moving its shared services into Azure over the next two quarters and has asked you to design and operate the network estate.

A single Azure subscription, Contoso-Prod, sits under a management group named Contoso. A second subscription, Contoso-Dev, was created by the application team last year and is not yet under that management group.

tabs.heading: Existing environment
paragraphs: Derby hosts an on-premises datacentre connected to Azure by a site-to-site VPN terminating on a virtual network gateway in a hub virtual network named vnet-hub (10.0.0.0/16). The gateway sits in GatewaySubnet.
Two spoke virtual networks are peered to vnet-hub: vnet-app (10.1.0.0/16) and vnet-data (10.2.0.0/16). Neither has a gateway of its own. The peerings were created with default settings.
A third virtual network, vnet-legacy (10.1.0.0/16), exists in Contoso-Dev and is not peered to anything.
All virtual machines run in vnet-app. They have no public IP addresses and reach the internet today through a public load balancer that was recently replaced with an internal one.
A storage account named contosoplantlogs receives telemetry from all three plants. It is currently reachable from any network.

tabs.heading: Requirements
paragraphs: Virtual machines in vnet-app and vnet-data must reach the Derby datacentre without deploying a gateway in either spoke.
Virtual machines in vnet-app must be able to reach the internet for operating-system updates. Administrators must not add a public IP address to any virtual machine.
Administrators must be able to open an RDP session to any virtual machine without exposing port 3389 to the internet and without giving any machine a public IP address.
The contosoplantlogs storage account must be reachable from vnet-data and from the Derby datacentre over the VPN, using a private address, and must not be reachable from the public internet.
vnet-legacy must eventually be joined to the hub. Any proposal must account for its addressing.
Cost must be kept as low as the other requirements allow.
